END_IF;
rVaporDensity_kgm3 := (rVoted_ColumnHeadPress_bar * 100.0 * rMolarMass_Ar_kgkmol) / (rIdealGasConstant_R * rVoted_TopTemp_K);
IF rVaporDensity_kgm3 > 0.1 THEN
    rFFactor_Packing_Pam05 := rSuperficialVaporVel_ms * SQRT(rVaporDensity_kgm3);
ELSE
    rFFactor_Packing_Pam05 := 1.258;
END_IF;

(* Flooding Boundary Estimation: Critical F-factor = 2.1 Pa^0.5 *)
rFloodingPercent := (rFFactor_Packing_Pam05 / 2.10) * 100.0;
IF rFloodingPercent > 100.0 THEN rFloodingPercent := 100.0; END_IF;

(* Dynamic Height Equivalent to a Theoretical Plate (HETP) via Onda Packed Bed Model *)
rColumnHETP_m := 0.160 + 0.035 * (rFFactor_Packing_Pam05 / 1.50) + 0.00025 * rVoted_DiffPress_mbar;
IF rColumnHETP_m < 0.140 THEN rColumnHETP_m := 0.140; END_IF;
IF rColumnHETP_m > 0.350 THEN rColumnHETP_m := 0.350; END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: CRYOGENIC PELTIER HEAT-PUMP CONDENSER REBALANCE ENGINE                             *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Peltier Thermoelectric Cooling Capacity Calculation:                                          *)
(* Q_cold = Sm * I * T_c - 0.5 * I^2 * Re - Kth * (T_h - T_c)                                   *)
rPeltierHeatRemoved_kW := (rPeltierSeebeckCoeff_VK * rPeltierCurrentFeedback_A * rPeltierColdFaceTemp_K) -
                          (0.50 * rPeltierCurrentFeedback_A * rPeltierCurrentFeedback_A * rPeltierResistance_Ohm) -
                          (rPeltierConductance_WK * (rPeltierHeatSinkTemp_K - rPeltierColdFaceTemp_K));
rPeltierHeatRemoved_kW := rPeltierHeatRemoved_kW * 0.001; (* Convert W to kW *)
IF rPeltierHeatRemoved_kW < 0.0 THEN rPeltierHeatRemoved_kW := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Thermoelectric Input Electrical Power: P_elec = I^2 * Re + Sm * I * (T_h - T_c) [kW] *)
rPeltierPowerCmd_kW := ((rPeltierCurrentFeedback_A * rPeltierCurrentFeedback_A * rPeltierResistance_Ohm) +
                        (rPeltierSeebeckCoeff_VK * rPeltierCurrentFeedback_A * (rPeltierHeatSinkTemp_K - rPeltierColdFaceTemp_K))) * 0.001;
IF rPeltierPowerCmd_kW < 0.001 THEN rPeltierPowerCmd_kW := 0.001; END_IF;

(* Coefficient of Performance (COP) *)
rPeltierEffectiveCOP := rPeltierHeatRemoved_kW / rPeltierPowerCmd_kW;
IF rPeltierEffectiveCOP > 6.0 THEN rPeltierEffectiveCOP := 6.0; END_IF;

(* Peltier Heat Sink Overheat Interlock *)
IF rPeltierHeatSinkTemp_K > 110.0 THEN
    rPeltierCurrentCmd_A := 0.0; (* Thermal runaway protection trip *)
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#0000_0800; (* Bit 11: PELTIER_HEAT_SINK_OVERHEAT *)
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: PROCESS ANALYTICAL TECHNOLOGY (PAT) GAS CHROMATOGRAPH & SMITH PREDICTOR            *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Detect Analytical Cycle Complete Edge from Redundant GC Units *)
bGC_NewDataArrived := (bGC_DataValid_A AND NOT bGC_StrobePrev_A) OR (bGC_DataValid_B AND NOT bGC_StrobePrev_B);
bGC_StrobePrev_A := bGC_DataValid_A;
bGC_StrobePrev_B := bGC_DataValid_B;

(* Push Real-Time High-Frequency State-Space Model Predictions into Circular FIFO Buffer *)
aFIFO_Pred_O2[iFIFO_Index] := aOutput_y[1];
aFIFO_Pred_N2[iFIFO_Index] := aOutput_y[0];
iFIFO_Index := iFIFO_Index + 1;
IF iFIFO_Index >= 360 THEN iFIFO_Index := 0; END_IF;

(* Upon New GC Chromatogram Data Arrival: Compute Innovation Residue and Correct Smith Bias *)
IF bGC_NewDataArrived AND NOT bGC_InCalibration THEN
    (* Compare delayed prediction from FIFO slot with physical GC analytical measurement *)
    rSmithBias_O2 := rVoted_GC_TraceO2_ppm - aFIFO_Pred_O2[iFIFO_Index];
    rSmithBias_N2 := rVoted_GC_TraceN2_ppm - aFIFO_Pred_N2[iFIFO_Index];
    (* Clamp Maximum Bias Step to Prevent GC Baseline Glitches *)
    IF rSmithBias_O2 > 0.250 THEN rSmithBias_O2 := 0.250; END_IF;
    IF rSmithBias_O2 < -0.250 THEN rSmithBias_O2 := -0.250; END_IF;
    IF rSmithBias_N2 > 0.350 THEN rSmithBias_N2 := 0.350; END_IF;
    IF rSmithBias_N2 < -0.350 THEN rSmithBias_N2 := -0.350; END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Dead-Time Compensated Online Product Quality Estimates *)
rPredictedTraceO2_ppm := aOutput_y[1] + rSmithBias_O2;
rPredictedTraceN2_ppm := aOutput_y[0] + rSmithBias_N2;
IF rPredictedTraceO2_ppm < 0.001 THEN rPredictedTraceO2_ppm := 0.001; END_IF;
IF rPredictedTraceN2_ppm < 0.001 THEN rPredictedTraceN2_ppm := 0.001; END_IF;

(* Ultra-High-Purity Grade 6.0 Certificate of Analysis (COA) Status: <= 0.5 ppm O2 and <= 0.5 ppm N2 *)
bUltraPurityGrade60 := (rPredictedTraceO2_ppm <= 0.500) AND (rPredictedTraceN2_ppm <= 0.500) AND (iMachineState = 40);

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: 6x6 STATE-SPACE KALMAN FILTER OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC)            *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Disturbance Vector Normalization *)
aDisturb_d[0] := rVoted_FeedFlow_Nm3h - 1250.0;     (* Feed flow deviation *)
aDisturb_d[1] := rFeedNitrogenFrac_ppm - 1000.0;    (* Feed N2 impurity deviation *)
aDisturb_d[2] := rAmbientPressure_bar - 1.013;      (* Ambient pressure deviation *)

(* 1. Kalman Filter State Prediction: x_pred = A * x_hat + B * (u - u_base) + E * d *)
FOR rIdxTmp := 0 TO 5 DO
    rVecTmp := 0.0;
    FOR rJdxTmp := 0 TO 5 DO
        rVecTmp := rVecTmp + aMatrix_A[rIdxTmp, rJdxTmp] * aState_x_hat[rJdxTmp];
    END_FOR;
    FOR rJdxTmp := 0 TO 3 DO
        rVecTmp := rVecTmp + aMatrix_B[rIdxTmp, rJdxTmp] * (aControl_u[rJdxTmp] - aControl_u_base[rJdxTmp]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR rJdxTmp := 0 TO 2 DO
        rVecTmp := rVecTmp + aMatrix_E[rIdxTmp, rJdxTmp] * aDisturb_d[rJdxTmp];
    END_FOR;
    aState_x_pred[rIdxTmp] := rVecTmp;
END_FOR;

(* Output Measurement Vector Compilation *)
aOutput_y[0] := rPredictedTraceN2_ppm;
aOutput_y[1] := rPredictedTraceO2_ppm;
aOutput_y[2] := rSumpLiquidLevel_Pct;
aOutput_y[3] := rVoted_DiffPress_mbar;

(* Output Errors Against Targets *)
FOR rIdxTmp := 0 TO 3 DO
    aOutput_y_error[rIdxTmp] := aOutput_y[rIdxTmp] - aOutput_y_sp[rIdxTmp];
END_FOR;

(* 2. Kalman Filter Measurement Update: x_hat = x_pred + K_obs * (y_meas - C * x_pred) *)
FOR rIdxTmp := 0 TO 5 DO
    rVecTmp := 0.0;
    FOR rJdxTmp := 0 TO 3 DO
        (* Compute predicted measurement y_pred = C * x_pred *)
        rVecTmp := rVecTmp + aMatrix_K_obs[rIdxTmp, rJdxTmp] * (aOutput_y[rJdxTmp] -
                   (aMatrix_C[rJdxTmp, 0] * aState_x_pred[0] + aMatrix_C[rJdxTmp, 1] * aState_x_pred[1] +
                    aMatrix_C[rJdxTmp, 2] * aState_x_pred[2] + aMatrix_C[rJdxTmp, 3] * aState_x_pred[3] +
                    aMatrix_C[rJdxTmp, 4] * aState_x_pred[4] + aMatrix_C[rJdxTmp, 5] * aState_x_pred[5]));
    END_FOR;
    aState_x_hat[rIdxTmp] := aState_x_pred[rIdxTmp] + rVecTmp;
END_FOR;

(* 3. Model Predictive Control (MPC) Projected Gradient Optimization Engine *)
IF (iMachineState = 40) AND NOT bGracefulDegradation THEN
    bMPC_Active := TRUE;
    (* Compute Quadratic Cost Gradient: g = B^T * C^T * Q * error + R * du_prev *)
    FOR rIdxTmp := 0 TO 3 DO
        rVecTmp := 0.0;
        FOR rJdxTmp := 0 TO 3 DO
            rVecTmp := rVecTmp + (aMatrix_B[rJdxTmp, rIdxTmp] * aWeight_Q[rJdxTmp] * aOutput_y_error[rJdxTmp]);
        END_FOR;
        aGrad_g[rIdxTmp] := rVecTmp + aWeight_R[rIdxTmp] * aControl_du[rIdxTmp];
        aHessian_diag[rIdxTmp] := aWeight_R[rIdxTmp] + 0.150;
    END_FOR;

    (* Iterative Projected Gradient Descent with Box Constraints *)
    FOR iIterQP := 1 TO iMaxIterQP DO
        rGradNorm := 0.0;
        FOR rIdxTmp := 0 TO 3 DO
            (* Gradient Step *)
            aStep_du[rIdxTmp] := aControl_du[rIdxTmp] - (rAlphaStep / aHessian_diag[rIdxTmp]) * aGrad_g[rIdxTmp];
            (* Slew Rate Boundary Projection *)
            IF aStep_du[rIdxTmp] > aLimit_du_Max[rIdxTmp] THEN aStep_du[rIdxTmp] := aLimit_du_Max[rIdxTmp]; END_IF;
            IF aStep_du[rIdxTmp] < aLimit_du_Min[rIdxTmp] THEN aStep_du[rIdxTmp] := aLimit_du_Min[rIdxTmp]; END_IF;
            (* Actuator Physical Boundary Projection *)
            IF (aControl_u[rIdxTmp] + aStep_du[rIdxTmp]) > aLimit_u_Max[rIdxTmp] THEN
                aStep_du[rIdxTmp] := aLimit_u_Max[rIdxTmp] - aControl_u[rIdxTmp];
            END_IF;
            IF (aControl_u[rIdxTmp] + aStep_du[rIdxTmp]) < aLimit_u_Min[rIdxTmp] THEN
                aStep_du[rIdxTmp] := aLimit_u_Min[rIdxTmp] - aControl_u[rIdxTmp];
            END_IF;
            rGradNorm := rGradNorm + ABS(aStep_du[rIdxTmp] - aControl_du[rIdxTmp]);
            aControl_du[rIdxTmp] := aStep_du[rIdxTmp];
        END_FOR;
        IF rGradNorm < 0.005 THEN
            EXIT; (* Converged within tolerance *)
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Apply Optimal Control Increments *)
    aControl_u[0] := aControl_u[0] + aControl_du[0]; (* Liquid Argon Reflux *)
    aControl_u[1] := aControl_u[1] + aControl_du[1]; (* Distillate Draw Rate *)
    aControl_u[2] := aControl_u[2] + aControl_du[2]; (* Peltier Stack Current *)
    aControl_u[3] := aControl_u[3] + aControl_du[3]; (* Reboiler Valve Position *)
ELSE
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* GRACEFUL DEGRADATION: DECOUPLED GAIN-SCHEDULED PID FALLBACK CONTROLLERS                   *)
    (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    bMPC_Active := FALSE;
    (* Fallback PID Loop 1: Reflux Flow -> Trace Oxygen / Top Temp *)
    rPID_Integ_Reflux := rPID_Integ_Reflux + rPID_Ki_Reflux * (rPredictedTraceO2_ppm - aOutput_y_sp[1]) * tScanTime_s;
    IF rPID_Integ_Reflux > 5000.0 THEN rPID_Integ_Reflux := 5000.0; END_IF;
    IF rPID_Integ_Reflux < 2200.0 THEN rPID_Integ_Reflux := 2200.0; END_IF;
    aControl_u[0] := rPID_Integ_Reflux + rPID_Kp_Reflux * (rPredictedTraceO2_ppm - aOutput_y_sp[1]) +
                     rPID_Kd_Reflux * ((rPredictedTraceO2_ppm - aOutput_y_sp[1]) - rPID_PrevErr_Reflux) / tScanTime_s;
    rPID_PrevErr_Reflux := (rPredictedTraceO2_ppm - aOutput_y_sp[1]);

    (* Fallback PID Loop 2: Distillate Draw -> Top Purity / Sump Level Balance *)
    rPID_Integ_Dist := rPID_Integ_Dist - rPID_Ki_Dist * (rPredictedTraceN2_ppm - aOutput_y_sp[0]) * tScanTime_s;
    IF rPID_Integ_Dist > 175.0 THEN rPID_Integ_Dist := 175.0; END_IF;
    IF rPID_Integ_Dist < 35.0 THEN rPID_Integ_Dist := 35.0; END_IF;
    aControl_u[1] := rPID_Integ_Dist - rPID_Kp_Dist * (rPredictedTraceN2_ppm - aOutput_y_sp[0]);

    (* Fallback PID Loop 3: Peltier Thermoelectric Current -> Overhead Condenser Pressure *)
    rPID_Integ_Peltier := rPID_Integ_Peltier + rPID_Ki_Peltier * (rVoted_ColumnHeadPress_bar - 1.350) * tScanTime_s;
    IF rPID_Integ_Peltier > 26.0 THEN rPID_Integ_Peltier := 26.0; END_IF;
    IF rPID_Integ_Peltier < 0.0 THEN rPID_Integ_Peltier := 0.0; END_IF;
    aControl_u[2] := rPID_Integ_Peltier + rPID_Kp_Peltier * (rVoted_ColumnHeadPress_bar - 1.350);

    (* Fallback PID Loop 4: Sump Reboiler Heating Valve -> Sump Liquid Holdup Level *)
    rPID_Integ_Reboiler := rPID_Integ_Reboiler + rPID_Ki_Reboiler * (rSumpLiquidLevel_Pct - aOutput_y_sp[2]) * tScanTime_s;
    IF rPID_Integ_Reboiler > 90.0 THEN rPID_Integ_Reboiler := 90.0; END_IF;
    IF rPID_Integ_Reboiler < 15.0 THEN rPID_Integ_Reboiler := 15.0; END_IF;
    aControl_u[3] := rPID_Integ_Reboiler + rPID_Kp_Reboiler * (rSumpLiquidLevel_Pct - aOutput_y_sp[2]);
END_IF;

(* Final Actuator Boundary Saturation Clamping *)
IF aControl_u[0] > aLimit_u_Max[0] THEN aControl_u[0] := aLimit_u_Max[0]; END_IF;
IF aControl_u[0] < aLimit_u_Min[0] THEN aControl_u[0] := aLimit_u_Min[0]; END_IF;
IF aControl_u[1] > aLimit_u_Max[1] THEN aControl_u[1] := aLimit_u_Max[1]; END_IF;
IF aControl_u[1] < aLimit_u_Min[1] THEN aControl_u[1] := aLimit_u_Min[1]; END_IF;
IF aControl_u[2] > aLimit_u_Max[2] THEN aControl_u[2] := aLimit_u_Max[2]; END_IF;
IF aControl_u[2] < aLimit_u_Min[2] THEN aControl_u[2] := aLimit_u_Min[2]; END_IF;
IF aControl_u[3] > aLimit_u_Max[3] THEN aControl_u[3] := aLimit_u_Max[3]; END_IF;
IF aControl_u[3] < aLimit_u_Min[3] THEN aControl_u[3] := aLimit_u_Min[3]; END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: ISA-18.2 MULTI-STAGE SEQUENTIAL FINITE STATE MACHINE                               *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
rStateElapsedTime_s := rStateElapsedTime_s + tScanTime_s;

CASE iMachineState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: IDLE / COLD_STANDBY *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bUltraPurityGrade60     := FALSE;
        bOffSpecDiversion       := FALSE;
        rRefluxFlowCmd_Nm3h     := 0.0;
        rDistillateDrawCmd_Nm3h := 0.0;
        rPeltierCurrentCmd_A    := 0.0;
        rReboilerValvePos_Pct   := 0.0;
        rOffSpecVentValve_Pct   := 0.0;
        IF bEnable AND bEmergencyStop THEN
            iMachineState       := 10; (* Transition to Pre-cooling Chilldown *)
            rStateElapsedTime_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: PRE_COOLING_CHILLDOWN *)
        (* Controlled Cryogenic Chilldown Ramp Rate < 1.5 K/min to Protect Aluminum Coldbox *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bUltraPurityGrade60     := FALSE;
        bOffSpecDiversion       := TRUE; (* Off-spec venting open *)
        rDistillateDrawCmd_Nm3h := 0.0;
        rRefluxFlowCmd_Nm3h     := 2400.0; (* Pre-charge cryogenic liquid argon reflux *)
        rPeltierCurrentCmd_A    := 8.0;    (* Gentle thermoelectric precooling *)
        rReboilerValvePos_Pct   := 15.0;   (* Mild reboiler boilup *)
        rOffSpecVentValve_Pct   := 45.0;   (* Purge warm vapor to vent header *)

        rCooldownRampRate_Kmin := (rVoted_TopTemp_K - rPrev_TT_A) * (60.0 / tScanTime_s);
        (* Check if Column has reached Cryogenic Saturation Equilibrium (< 88.0 K) *)
        IF (rVoted_TopTemp_K <= 88.0) AND (rVoted_SumpTemp_K <= 91.0) AND (rStateElapsedTime_s >= 600.0) THEN
            iMachineState       := 20; (* Transition to Liquid Inventory Charging *)
            rStateElapsedTime_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: LIQUID_INVENTORY_CHARGING *)
        (* Establishing Liquid Sump Holdup and Packed Bed Wetting *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bUltraPurityGrade60     := FALSE;
        bOffSpecDiversion       := TRUE;
        rDistillateDrawCmd_Nm3h := 0.0;
        rRefluxFlowCmd_Nm3h     := 3200.0;
        rPeltierCurrentCmd_A    := 12.0;
        rReboilerValvePos_Pct   := 35.0;
        rOffSpecVentValve_Pct   := 20.0;

        IF (rSumpLiquidLevel_Pct >= 50.0) AND (rVoted_DiffPress_mbar >= 30.0) AND (rStateElapsedTime_s >= 300.0) THEN
            iMachineState       := 30; (* Transition to Total Reflux VLE Profile Establishment *)
            rStateElapsedTime_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: TOTAL_REFLUX_VLE_DEVELOPMENT *)
        (* 100% Total Reflux (R -> infinity, D = 0) to Establish 220 Theoretical Tray Profile *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bUltraPurityGrade60     := FALSE;
        bOffSpecDiversion       := TRUE;
        rDistillateDrawCmd_Nm3h := 0.0;     (* Zero product draw during total reflux *)
        rRefluxFlowCmd_Nm3h     := 4200.0;  (* High reflux flux *)
        rPeltierCurrentCmd_A    := 18.0;    (* Full Peltier dephlegmator condensing *)
        rReboilerValvePos_Pct   := 58.0;    (* Nominal vapor boilup *)
        rOffSpecVentValve_Pct   := 5.0;     (* Minimum non-condensable N2 vent purge *)

        (* Verify Separation Profile: Top Temp Stable near 87.3 K, Trace O2 < 1.0 ppm *)
        IF (rPredictedTraceO2_ppm <= 0.800) AND (rVoted_TopTemp_K <= 87.40) AND (rStateElapsedTime_s >= 900.0) THEN
            iMachineState       := 40; (* Transition to Active MPC Super-fractionation *)
            rStateElapsedTime_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: ACTIVE_MPC_SUPERFRACTIONATION *)
        (* Normal Steady-State Ultra-High-Purity Production Mode *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bOffSpecDiversion       := NOT bUltraPurityGrade60;
        rRefluxFlowCmd_Nm3h     := aControl_u[0];
        rDistillateDrawCmd_Nm3h := aControl_u[1];
        rPeltierCurrentCmd_A    := aControl_u[2];
        rReboilerValvePos_Pct   := aControl_u[3];
        IF bUltraPurityGrade60 THEN
            rOffSpecVentValve_Pct := 0.0;  (* Direct pure argon to product storage *)
        ELSE
            rOffSpecVentValve_Pct := 30.0; (* Divert off-spec argon to recovery tank *)
        END_IF;

        (* Oxygen Breakthrough or Severe Nitrogen Incursion Detection *)
        IF (rPredictedTraceO2_ppm > 2.0) OR (rPredictedTraceN2_ppm > 5.0) THEN
            iMachineState       := 60; (* Transition to Upset Argon Dump Recovery *)
            rStateElapsedTime_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Routine PAT Gas Chromatograph Auto-Calibration Trigger *)
        IF bGC_InCalibration THEN
            iMachineState       := 50; (* Transition to GC PAT Standardization *)
            rStateElapsedTime_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: GC_PAT_STANDARDIZATION_CYCLE *)
        (* Analytical Auto-Zero / Span Calibration Mode *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;   (* Maintain production under frozen observer state *)
        rRefluxFlowCmd_Nm3h     := aControl_u[0];
        rDistillateDrawCmd_Nm3h := aControl_u[1];
        rPeltierCurrentCmd_A    := aControl_u[2];
        rReboilerValvePos_Pct   := aControl_u[3];
        rOffSpecVentValve_Pct   := 0.0;
        IF NOT bGC_InCalibration OR (rStateElapsedTime_s >= 600.0) THEN
            iMachineState       := 40; (* Return to Active MPC Production *)
            rStateElapsedTime_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: UPSET_ARGON_DUMP_MITIGATION *)
        (* Rapid Mitigation for Oxygen Wave or Nitrogen Blanket Incursion *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bUltraPurityGrade60     := FALSE;
        bOffSpecDiversion       := TRUE;   (* Force off-spec diversion *)
        rDistillateDrawCmd_Nm3h := 0.0;    (* Shut off product draw immediately *)
        rRefluxFlowCmd_Nm3h     := 4800.0; (* Maximize liquid reflux to suppress rising O2 wave *)
        rPeltierCurrentCmd_A    := 24.0;   (* Maximize dephlegmator subcooling *)
        rReboilerValvePos_Pct   := 45.0;   (* Lower boilup to de-load top stages *)
        rOffSpecVentValve_Pct   := 75.0;   (* Open top non-condensable purge vent *)

        (* Check if Purity Recovered Below Thresholds *)
        IF (rPredictedTraceO2_ppm <= 0.400) AND (rPredictedTraceN2_ppm <= 0.450) AND (rStateElapsedTime_s >= 450.0) THEN
            iMachineState       := 40; (* Re-enter Normal Active Production *)
            rStateElapsedTime_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: CONTROLLED_WARMUP_DERIMING *)
        (* De-icing / Warmup Regeneration Cycle with Dry Nitrogen *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bUltraPurityGrade60     := FALSE;
        bOffSpecDiversion       := TRUE;
        rDistillateDrawCmd_Nm3h := 0.0;
        rRefluxFlowCmd_Nm3h     := 0.0;
        rPeltierCurrentCmd_A    := 0.0;
        rReboilerValvePos_Pct   := 0.0;
        rOffSpecVentValve_Pct   := 100.0;  (* Completely open venting header *)
        IF rStateElapsedTime_s >= 3600.0 THEN
            iMachineState       := 0; (* Cold Standby *)
            rStateElapsedTime_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE 99: EMERGENCY_SAFE_HOLD *)
        (* SIL-3 Safety Lockout State *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bUltraPurityGrade60     := FALSE;
        bOffSpecDiversion       := TRUE;
        rRefluxFlowCmd_Nm3h     := 2100.0; (* Minimum wetting flow *)
        rDistillateDrawCmd_Nm3h := 0.0;
        rPeltierCurrentCmd_A    := 0.0;
        rReboilerValvePos_Pct   := 0.0;
        rOffSpecVentValve_Pct   := 100.0;
        IF bEmergencyStop AND bAcknowledgeAlarms THEN
            iMachineState       := 0; (* Reset to Cold Standby *)
            rStateElapsedTime_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;
END_CASE;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 8: MULTI-TIER ISA-18.2 ALARM MATRIX & DIAGNOSTIC WORD GENERATION                       *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Alarm Acknowledgment Logic *)
IF bAcknowledgeAlarms THEN
    dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord AND 16#8000_0000; (* Retain latching trips only *)
END_IF;

(* Bit 0: Trace Oxygen High Warning (> 0.500 ppm) *)
IF rPredictedTraceO2_ppm > 0.500 THEN dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#0000_0001; END_IF;
(* Bit 1: Trace Oxygen High-High Trip (> 1.000 ppm) *)
IF rPredictedTraceO2_ppm > 1.000 THEN dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#0000_0002; END_IF;
(* Bit 2: Trace Nitrogen High Warning (> 0.500 ppm) *)
IF rPredictedTraceN2_ppm > 0.500 THEN dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#0000_0004; END_IF;
(* Bit 3: Trace Nitrogen High-High Trip (> 2.000 ppm) *)
IF rPredictedTraceN2_ppm > 2.000 THEN dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#0000_0008; END_IF;
(* Bit 4: Column Hydraulic Flooding Warning (> 85.0 %) *)
IF rFloodingPercent > 85.0 THEN dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#0000_0010; END_IF;
(* Bit 5: Column Hydraulic Weeping Warning (< 25.0 %) *)
IF rFloodingPercent < 25.0 THEN dwAlarmStatusWord := dwAlarmStatusWord OR 16#0000_0020; END_IF;
(* Bit 6: Packed Bed Differential Pressure High (> 65.0 mbar) *)
